title: A Shooting at the Tree of Life Synagogue

sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等众多嘉宾。

sentences.en: The massacre at the Tree of Life Synagogue in Pittsburgh was the worst attack on the Jewish community in the United States in decades.
sentences.zh: 匹兹堡生命树犹太会所的大屠杀是美国几十年来针对犹太社区的最严重袭击。

sentences.en: The city's mayor called it the darkest day of Pittsburgh's history.
sentences.zh: 该市市长称这是匹兹堡历史上最黑暗的一天。

sentences.en: Monday, October 29th.
sentences.zh: 10月29日，星期一。

sentences.en: We begin with yet another terrible day of gun violence in America.
sentences.zh: 我们从美国又一个枪支暴力的可怕日子开始说起。

sentences.en: This time, the attack was at a temple in Pittsburgh.
sentences.zh: 这一次，袭击发生在匹兹堡的一座犹太会所。

sentences.en: It has been a frightening week in the United
sentences.zh: 对美国来说，这是一个令人恐慌的星期，

sentences.en: States, and many Americans are worried about the direction their country is taking.
sentences.zh: 许多美国人开始担心他们国家正在走向何方。

sentences.en: Kevin Roos, it feels important to know what was going on in synagogues across the country last week.
sentences.zh: 凯文·罗斯，了解上周全国各地犹太会所里发生了什么，似乎非常重要。

sentences.en: Well, it was something called the National Refugee Shabbat, which is a sort of annual tradition
sentences.zh: 嗯，那是一个名为“全国难民安息日”（National Refugee Shabbat）的活动，这算是一种年度传统，

sentences.en: that was started by this group called HIAS, which stands for Hebrew Immigrant Aid Society.
sentences.zh: 由一个名为HIAS的组织发起，其全称为希伯来移民救助协会（Hebrew Immigrant Aid Society）。

sentences.en: And it's an organization that was founded in the 19th century to help Jews who were fleeing persecution in Eastern Europe.
sentences.zh: 这是一个成立于19世纪的组织，旨在帮助逃离东欧迫害的犹太人。

sentences.en: And since then, it has sort of expanded to become a kind of pro-refugee group of Jewish activists who help people who are seeking asylum, people who are fleeing persecution.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，它逐渐扩大规模，变成了一个犹太活动人士组成的亲难民组织，专门帮助那些寻求庇护、逃离迫害的人。

sentences.en: It's a pretty well-known group within the Jewish community.
sentences.zh: 在犹太社区里，这是一个相当知名的组织。

sentences.en: And every year, they commemorate a special Shabbat service for refugees in synagogues all around the country.
sentences.zh: 每年，他们都会在全国各地的犹太会所里举行特殊的难民安息日礼拜来纪念这一活动。

sentences.en: And that feels very much in keeping with the history of Judaism itself, which is
sentences.zh: 这感觉非常符合犹太教本身的历史，

sentences.en: that of a people who are stateless and wandering and searching for a home and sympathetic with those who are doing the same.
sentences.zh: 也就是一个无国籍、四处流浪、寻觅家园并同情有着相同遭遇之人的民族的历史。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And what connects this to the shooter?
sentences.zh: 这与枪手有什么联系呢？

sentences.en: Well, we know that he knew about it because he posted it on a social media site called Gab, which is kind of like a cross between something like Twitter and Reddit.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们知道他是知情的，因为他在一个名叫Gab的社交媒体网站上发过帖，这个网站有点像Twitter和Reddit的结合体。

sentences.en: And it's a place where a lot of white nationalists and neo-Nazis and sort of far-right extremists have gathered to communicate with each other.
sentences.zh: 那里聚集了大量的白人民族主义者、新纳粹分子以及各种极右翼极端分子，他们在那里互相交流。

sentences.en: And what did he say about this refugee Shabbat?
sentences.zh: 关于这个难民安息日，他是怎么说的？

sentences.en: So he posted the screenshot of the website where the details of this Shabbat were given out and a link to the list of participating synagogues.
sentences.zh: 他发布了提供此次安息日详细信息的网站截图，以及参与犹太会所名单的链接。

sentences.en: And he accused HIAS of bringing in hostile invaders to dwell among us.
sentences.zh: 他指责HIAS将敌对的入侵者引入并居住在我们中间。

sentences.en: And by that, he meant the refugees.
sentences.zh: 他指的正是那些难民。

sentences.en: Tonight, President Trump is doubling down on unsupported claims and scare tactics as a caravan of migrants heads closer to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 今晚，正当一队移民队伍向美国边境逼近、穿过墨西哥向北行进时，特朗普总统再次坚称那些未经证实的说法和恐吓战术。

sentences.en: border, marching north through Mexico.
sentences.zh: 边境，向北穿过墨西哥行进。

sentences.en: We know that he posted several messages about the caravan of migrants.
sentences.zh: 我们知道他发布了几条关于移民大篷车队伍的消息。

sentences.en: Mr. Trump insisting that unknown Middle Easterners, his words, unknown Middle Easterners, are now in the crowds as well as criminals without offering any evidence.
sentences.zh: 特朗普先生在没有任何证据的情况下坚称，所谓的“中东不明人员”（他的原话）以及罪犯现在也混杂在人群之中。

sentences.en: And he believed that this was also part of a Jewish conspiracy, that Jewish groups were funding and supporting these migrants trying to get across the border into the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他认为这也是一场犹太阴谋的一部分，即犹太集团正在资助和支持这些试图穿过边境进入美国的移民。

sentences.en: And he shared a message on his Gab feed that said that the filthy, evil Jews are bringing the filthy, evil Muslims into the country.
sentences.zh: 他在自己的Gab动态中分享了一条消息，称“肮脏、邪恶的犹太人正在将肮脏、邪恶的穆斯林带入这个国家”。

sentences.en: And what happened on Saturday?
sentences.zh: 星期六发生了什么？

sentences.en: So from what we know, on Saturday morning, he got into his car and drove to the synagogue.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，周六早上，他上了车并驱车前往犹太会所。

sentences.en: And at 9.49 a.m., he went on to Gab and posted a final message.
sentences.zh: 上午9点49分，他登录Gab发布了最后一条消息。

sentences.en: And he wrote, I can't sit by and watch my people get slaughtered.
sentences.zh: 他写道：“我不能袖手旁观，看着我的人民被屠杀。”

sentences.en: Screw your optics.
sentences.zh: “去你的公众形象。”

sentences.en: I'm going in.
sentences.zh: “我要大干一场了。”

sentences.en: And then we know that about five minutes later, a 911 call came in that was reporting an active shooting in the synagogue.
sentences.zh: 然后我们了解到，大约五分钟后，一个911报警电话打进来，报告犹太会所内发生枪击事件。

sentences.en: He carried four guns with him, according to police.
sentences.zh: 据警方称，他随身携带了四把枪。

sentences.en: And as he entered, he shouted that he wanted all Jews to die and began shooting.
sentences.zh: 当他闯入时，他大喊着希望所有犹太人都去死，然后开始开枪。

sentences.en: What do we know about this man?
sentences.zh: 我们对这个男人了解多少？

sentences.en: We know that Robert Bowers is 46 years old.
sentences.zh: 我们知道罗伯特·鲍尔斯（Robert Bowers）今年46岁。

sentences.en: He lives about half an hour south of the synagogue in a kind of rundown apartment.
sentences.zh: 他住在犹太会所以南大约半小时车程的一处破旧公寓里。

sentences.en: And according to our colleagues at the Times who have talked to his neighbors and gone to his apartment, his neighbors said they don't really know much about him.
sentences.zh: 根据我们在《时报》的同事采访其邻居并探访其公寓后所说，邻居们表示他们对他其实并不了解。

sentences.en: They don't remember him talking to anyone.
sentences.zh: 他们不记得他和任何人说过话。

sentences.en: They don't remember him having much of a social life at all.
sentences.zh: 他们不记得他有什么真正的社交生活。

sentences.en: He doesn't have a lot of footprints other than online.
sentences.zh: 除了在网络上，他几乎没有留下什么足迹。

sentences.en: And most of what we know about him at this point, we know because he had this account on Gab.
sentences.zh: 此时我们对他的大部分了解，都源于他在Gab上拥有这个账号。

sentences.en: Time now for our Defending the First series where we expose the enemies of the First Amendment, free expression and free thought.
sentences.zh: 现在是我们的“捍卫第一修正案”系列节目，我们将在此揭露第一修正案、言论自由和思想自由的敌人。

sentences.en: If you remember a few years ago, there started to be this narrative about censorship by Silicon
sentences.zh: 如果你还记得几年前，开始流传这样一种说法，即硅谷科技公司存在言论审查。

sentences.en: Valley tech companies.
sentences.zh: 谷科技公司。

sentences.en: The Media Research Center released a devastating report today, documenting the censorship of conservative speech by Silicon Valley's tolerant tech giant.
sentences.zh: 媒体研究中心今天发布了一份极具杀伤力的报告，记录了硅谷这位奉行宽容的科技巨头对保守派言论的审查。

sentences.en: And especially sort of Twitter and Facebook being accused of bias against conservatives.
sentences.zh: 尤其是Twitter和Facebook被指控对保守派存在偏见。

sentences.en: Gab is an ad-free social media platform that operates in a way similar to Twitter.
sentences.zh: Gab是一个无广告的社交媒体平台，其运作方式与Twitter类似。

sentences.en: And Gab sort of came out of that controversy.
sentences.zh: Gab可以说正是从那场争议中诞生的。

sentences.en: It was started by a conservative programmer in
sentences.zh: 它是由硅谷的一位保守派程序员发起的，

sentences.en: Silicon Valley who was sort of fed up with what he saw as excessive political correctness.
sentences.zh: 他实在是受够了他所看到的那些过度的政治正确。

sentences.en: So when we founded Gab, we founded it specifically to avoid this purpose.
sentences.zh: 所以当我们创立Gab时，我们创立它的目的就是为了明确避开这一点。

sentences.en: I didn't want to police speech.
sentences.zh: 我不想对言论进行监管。

sentences.en: I believed in free speech for everybody, individual liberty for everybody and the free flow of information for everybody.
sentences.zh: 我相信每个人的言论自由、每个人的个人自由以及信息的自由流动。

sentences.en: But they don't.
sentences.zh: 但他们却没有。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: What's happening in Silicon Valley right now is they're using these arbitrary hate speech policies.
sentences.zh: 硅谷现在发生的事情是，他们正在使用这些随心所欲的仇恨言论政策。

sentences.en: And as a result of the fact that it had very few rules, there were no rules against hate speech.
sentences.zh: 由于该平台几乎没有什么规则，没有任何针对仇恨言论的规定，

sentences.en: They weren't doing a ton of censorship as pretty much anything goes.
sentences.zh: 他们没有进行大量的审查，基本上可以说是百无禁忌。

sentences.en: A lot of the more prominent people who joined were people who had been kicked off of other platforms for being too extremes.
sentences.zh: 许多加入的较为知名的人士，都是因为过于极端而被其他平台踢出去的人。

sentences.en: Like who?
sentences.zh: 比如谁？

sentences.en: Well, Milo Yiannopoulos, a right wing internet troll, used to write for Breitbart.
sentences.zh: 嗯，米洛·扬亚普洛斯（Milo Yiannopoulos），一个右翼网络喷子，曾为布赖特巴特新闻网（Breitbart）撰稿。

sentences.en: He joined Gab.
sentences.zh: 他加入了Gab。

sentences.en: Richard Spencer, the prominent white nationalist, joined Gab.
sentences.zh: 理查德·斯潘塞（Richard Spencer），这位知名的白人民族主义者，加入了Gab。

sentences.en: Jason Kessler, who organized the rally in
sentences.zh: 杰森·凯斯勒（Jason Kessler），组织了

sentences.en: Charlottesville.
sentences.zh: 夏洛茨维尔集会的人。

sentences.en: Andrew Anglin, the publisher of the Daily Stormer, which is a neo-Nazi website.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁·安格林（Andrew Anglin），新纳粹网站《每日风暴》（Daily Stormer）的出版人。

sentences.en: He was an early member of Gab.
sentences.zh: 他是Gab的早期成员。

sentences.en: And all of these people flocked there because Gab would allow them to say pretty much whatever they wanted.
sentences.zh: 所有这些人之所以蜂拥而至，是因为Gab允许他们畅所欲言，想说什么就说什么。

sentences.en: There are other people on Gab, too.
sentences.zh: Gab上也有其他人。

sentences.en: Obviously, they have something like 700,000 members.
sentences.zh: 显然，他们拥有大约70万会员。

sentences.en: But the most visible stuff on the site was always the kind of shocking, racist, anti-Semitic, far-right content that was being shoved off of more popular platforMs.
sentences.zh: 但网站上最显眼的内容，总是那些被主流平台挤压出去的、令人震惊的、种族主义的、反犹太的极右翼内容。

sentences.en: And what about Bowers?
sentences.zh: 那鲍尔斯呢？

sentences.en: What have you been able to learn from his postings on Gab?
sentences.zh: 通过他在Gab上的发帖，你们了解到了什么？

sentences.en: Well, he joined the site in January, and we've been able to recover some of his posts.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他在1月份加入了该网站，我们已经能够恢复他的一些帖子。

sentences.en: They've been taken down, but we have an archive of some of them.
sentences.zh: 它们已经被删除了，但我们有一些帖子的存档。

sentences.en: And going through them, it sort of gives you the impression that he was obsessed with anti-Semitism.
sentences.zh: 翻看这些内容，会给人一种印象，即他有反犹太主义狂热。

sentences.en: I mean, substantially, all of the posts that he posted and reposted were about Jews, were about conspiracy theories, about Jews controlling the world.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，基本上他发布和转发的所有帖子都与犹太人有关，都与犹太人控制世界的阴谋论有关。

sentences.en: He was critical of President Trump because he thought that President Trump was too accommodating of Jews.
sentences.zh: 他批评特朗普总统，因为他认为特朗普总统对犹太人太迁就了。

sentences.en: He used a ton of anti-Semitic slurs and stereotypes.
sentences.zh: 他使用了大量的反犹太主义污蔑言论和刻板印象。

sentences.en: I mean, there was really nothing else of substance on his profile other than anti-Semitism.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，除了反犹太主义之外，他的个人资料里真的没有其他实质性内容了。

sentences.en: So this was Bowers, Kevin, really making use of Gab as it was designed to be used as a far more lenient platform than Twitter, than Facebook.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是鲍尔斯，凯文，他确实充分利用了Gab被设计时的初衷——作为一个比Twitter和Facebook远为宽容的平台。

sentences.en: Well, right before this shooting, we had another act of domestic terrorism, which was this mail bombing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，就在这次枪击事件发生前不久，我们发生了另一起国内恐怖主义行为，也就是邮包炸弹案。

sentences.en: Bombs sent through the mail to prominent
sentences.zh: 通过邮局寄给知名

sentences.en: Democrats and news organizations like CNN.
sentences.zh: 民主党人和CNN等新闻机构的炸弹。

sentences.en: And the suspect in that case, this guy from Florida,
sentences.zh: 该案的嫌疑人，来自佛罗里达州的这个人，

sentences.en: Cesar Sayoc, he also used social media to post sort of extreme and divisive content.
sentences.zh: 塞萨尔·萨约克（Cesar Sayoc），他也利用社交媒体发布一些极端和具有分裂性的内容。

sentences.en: But he did it in a different way.
sentences.zh: 但他使用的方式不同。

sentences.en: He was using Facebook and Twitter, which are kind of the big mainstream platforMs.
sentences.zh: 他使用的是Facebook和Twitter，也就是那些大型主流平台。

sentences.en: And he was using them to get into fights and attack people and engage people who he disagreed with.
sentences.zh: 他用它们来挑起争端、攻击他人并与他意见不合的人争论。

sentences.en: And that was sort of the appeal of that service to him was that everyone was there and he could find his enemies and communicate directly with them.
sentences.zh: 这项服务对他的吸引力就在于，每个人都在那里，他可以找到他的敌人并直接与他们交流。

sentences.en: Whereas Robert Bowers seems to have flocked to Gab for the opposite reason, because that was where the people who agreed with him were.
sentences.zh: 而罗伯特·鲍尔斯似乎出于相反的原因涌向Gab，因为那里才是和有着相同观点的人聚集的地方。

sentences.en: And that was where he could find a community of people who shared his views, who he could communicate openly with,
sentences.zh: 在那里他可以找到一个志同道合的群体，能够公开交流，

sentences.en: without sort of the watchful eye of the platform getting in the way.
sentences.zh: 而不会受到平台监管之眼的阻挠。

sentences.en: And you can really see the stark divide here if you go to Gab today in the aftermath of the shooting and look at the stuff that's being posted there.
sentences.zh: 如果你在枪击事件发生后去今天的Gab看看上面发布的内容，你确实能看到这里存在着一条鲜明的鸿沟。

sentences.en: And what is being posted there?
sentences.zh: 上面都发布了些什么？

sentences.en: So, um, we have a lot of posts that are celebrating Robert Bowers.
sentences.zh: 嗯，呃，我们有很多帖子在为罗伯特·鲍尔斯欢呼。

sentences.en: There's a hashtag that's being
sentences.zh: 有一个话题标签正在

sentences.en: Celebrating this mass shooting.
sentences.zh: 庆祝这场大规模枪击事件。

sentences.en: Celebrating the alleged shooter.
sentences.zh: 庆祝这位所谓的枪手。

sentences.en: There's a hashtag, Hero Robert Bowers.
sentences.zh: 有一个标签叫“英雄罗伯特·鲍尔斯”。

sentences.en: Free Robert Bowers.
sentences.zh: “释放罗伯特·鲍尔斯”。

sentences.en: I mean, it's just kind of the worst stuff you can imagine.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这简直是你所能想象到的最糟糕的东西。

sentences.en: Are you seeing anyone on this site saying that this was a horrific act, that this was wrong, abhorrent, and that's not what we stand for?
sentences.zh: 你有没有看到这个网站上有人说这是一起可怕的行径，这是错误的、令人厌恶的，这不代表我们的立场？

sentences.en: I'm looking around.
sentences.zh: 我四处看了看。

sentences.en: I'm looking at what's popular on the site.
sentences.zh: 我看了看网站上什么内容比较受欢迎。

sentences.en: I'm looking at what people are posting and I'm not seeing a lot of that.
sentences.zh: 我看了看大家都在发什么，但我没看到太多这样的声音。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: Kevin, you and I have talked about the fact that social media sites like Facebook and Twitter need to be stronger about policing this sort of speech that we're talking about.
sentences.zh: 凯文，你我都讨论过这样一个事实，即Facebook和Twitter等社交媒体网站需要对监管我们所讨论的那类言论采取更强硬的立场。

sentences.en: But I wonder if you're concerned that what we're seeing here with Gab might be a consequence of that.
sentences.zh: 但我不知道你是否担心，我们在Gab上看到的这一幕可能正是这种做法的后果。

sentences.en: That any crackdown at all has pushed people with more extreme views onto smaller and less public and more fringy social media sites where inevitably there's less oversight.
sentences.zh: 任何打击行动都已经把那些持有更极端观点的人推向了规模更小、公开性更低、更加边缘化的社交媒体网站，而那里不可避免地监管更少。

sentences.en: And also more people who hold equally extreme or more extreme perspectives.
sentences.zh: 同时，那里也有更多持有同样极端甚至更极端观点的人。

sentences.en: And is that a problematic outcome?
sentences.zh: 这是一个充满问题的结果吗？

sentences.en: Well, I think one thing that we do know for sure is that when people get kicked off of Twitter and Facebook and other large social media platforms, they don't just stop posting.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为有一点是我们确切知道的，那就是当人们被踢出Twitter、Facebook和其他大型社交媒体平台时，他们并不会就此停止发帖。

sentences.en: They don't go away.
sentences.zh: 他们并没有消失。

sentences.en: They find someplace else that will tolerate them or turn a blind eye.
sentences.zh: 他们会找到其他能够容忍他们或对此睁一只眼闭一只眼的地方。

sentences.en: And I think we have to get comfortable with the reality that one of the tradeoffs of having our biggest and most
sentences.zh: 我认为我们必须正视这样一个现实，即让我们的最大、最具影响力的社交平台变得更加健康、毒性更低所付出的代价之一，

sentences.en: influential social platforms be healthier and less toxic is that a lot of the worst stuff is going to get pushed into these smaller, more private enclaves.
sentences.zh: 就是许多最糟糕的内容将会被挤压到这些更小、更私密的群落中。

sentences.en: And there might not be any way to avoid that, even if it shuts down, even if something else takes its place.
sentences.zh: 而且可能没有任何办法可以避免这种情况，即使它被关闭，即使有其他东西取而代之。

sentences.en: So a healthy Twitter and Facebook may mean the existence of sites like Gab.
sentences.zh: 因此，一个健康的Twitter和Facebook可能意味着像Gab这样的网站的存在。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Kevin, what have you been thinking as you've been reporting on all this over the weekend?
sentences.zh: 凯文，这个周末你在报道这一切时，都在想些什么？

sentences.en: Because it feels like for many months we've been talking about the divisions on social media,
sentences.zh: 因为感觉好几个月以来我们一直在谈论社交媒体上的分歧，

sentences.en: mostly in terms of politics, what they meant in 2016, what they might mean for the midterMs.
sentences.zh: 主要是在政治方面，它们在2016年意味着什么，它们对中期选举可能意味着什么。

sentences.en: But it feels like the events of the past week have sort of exploded that idea that the stakes are actually far higher.
sentences.zh: 但感觉过去一周发生的事件彻底粉碎了那种想法，事态的利害关系其实要高得多。

sentences.en: We're talking not about how this divisiveness might affect people's votes, but about how it's getting into people's psyches and is doing unbelievable real world damage.
sentences.zh: 我们讨论的不再是这种分裂性可能会如何影响人们的投票，而是它如何渗入人们的心理，并正在造成难以置信的现实世界破坏。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think for the last several months, I've been covering social media with a focus on what
sentences.zh: 是的，我想在过去的几个月里，我一直在报道社交媒体，重点关注社交媒体上发生的所有这些行为会对某一场选举产生什么影响。

sentences.en: effect all of this behavior happening on social media would have on one set of elections.
sentences.zh: 而我意识到的是，事情远比这宏大得多，因为我们真正看到的是

sentences.en: And what I'm realizing is that it's far, far bigger than that, because what we're really seeing
sentences.zh: 事情远比这宏大得多，因为我们真正看到的是

sentences.en: is the kind of breakdown of the dividing line between online bad behavior and real world violence.
sentences.zh: 这是一种网络恶劣行为与现实世界暴力之间分界线的崩溃。

sentences.en: For a while, lots of people thought that because threats or abusive language were happening on the internet, that it was somehow less real, that it was less threatening to receive
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，很多人认为，因为威胁或虐待性言论发生在互联网上，所以它在某种程度上没有那么真实，

sentences.en: a death threat on Twitter than it would be to receive it over the phone or in person.
sentences.zh: 在推特上收到死亡威胁，比起在电话里或当面收到，威胁性要小一些。

sentences.en: And I think now we know that that's just not true, that often this stuff is one and the same,
sentences.zh: 我想现在我们知道这根本不是真的，通常这些事情其实是一回事，

sentences.en: that the threats and the conflict and the polarization that erupt online and in the media
sentences.zh: 网络和媒体上爆发的威胁、冲突和两极分化

sentences.en: can bleed over into real world violence and are doing it pretty frequently and in ways that are horrifying.
sentences.zh: 会蔓延到现实世界的暴力中，而且相当频繁，并以骇人听闻的方式发生着。

sentences.en: The consequences of all of this, of this stirring up of anger and hatred and polarization,
sentences.zh: 所有这一切的后果，即这种对愤怒、仇恨和两极分化的煽动，

sentences.en: I think are going to be with us for a long time.
sentences.zh: 我想将伴随我们很长一段时间。

sentences.en: It's a terrible, terrible thing, what's going on with hate in our country, frankly, and all over the world.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，我们国家乃至全世界仇恨的现状，是一件非常非常糟糕的事情。

sentences.en: And something has to be done.
sentences.zh: 必须采取一些行动了。

sentences.en: Something has to be done.
sentences.zh: 必须采取行动了。

sentences.en: Over the weekend, President Trump denounced the synagogue shooting in Pittsburgh, even as the
sentences.zh: 周末，特朗普总统谴责了匹兹堡犹太会堂枪击案，尽管

sentences.en: deaths revived questions about what signals he has sent, intentionally or not, to extremists across the country.
sentences.zh: 死伤事件再次引发了人们对他的质疑：他是否有意无意地向全国的极端分子发出了某种信号？

sentences.en: Have you ever asked him to please not use that type of language when referring to other people for the case of civil discourse in this country?
sentences.zh: 为了这个国家的文明对话，你有没有请求过他，在提及他人时请不要使用那种语言？

sentences.en: Everyone has their own style.
sentences.zh: 每个人都有自己的风格。

sentences.en: And frankly, people on both sides of the aisle use strong language about our political differences.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，两党的人在谈到我们的政治分歧时都使用了激烈的言辞。

sentences.en: But those around the president, including Vice President Mike Pence, rejected any linkage between Trump's language and the acts of isolated extremists.
sentences.zh: 但总统身边的人，包括副总统迈克·彭斯，拒绝将特朗普的言论与孤立极端分子的行为联系起来。

sentences.en: But I just don't think you can connect it to threats or acts of violence, Vaughn.
sentences.zh: 但我只是认为你不能把它同威胁或暴力行为联系起来，沃恩。

sentences.en: And I don't think the
sentences.zh: 而且我认为

sentences.en: American people connect it.
sentences.zh: 美国人民不会把它们联系起来。

sentences.en: The American people believe that those who are responsible are the people that actually conduct these threats.
sentences.zh: 美国人民认为，应当负责的人是那些真正实施这些威胁的人。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Words from Psalm 90.
sentences.zh: 出自《诗篇》第90篇。

sentences.en: Campbell, who were the people inside this synagogue on Saturday?
sentences.zh: 坎贝尔，周六这家犹太会堂里都是些什么人？

sentences.en: Well, Tree of Life was, you know, very prominent conservative synagogue.
sentences.zh: 嗯，“生命树”是一个，你知道的，非常知名的保守派犹太会堂。

sentences.en: The congregation itself goes back over a hundred years.
sentences.zh: 这个会众群体可以追溯到一百多年前。

sentences.en: Oh, God, you have been our refuge in every generation.
sentences.zh: 哦，上帝啊，世世代代你一直是我们的避难所。

sentences.en: Before the mountains...
sentences.zh: 在群山出现之前……

sentences.en: And the gunman came in just about five minutes after services were to begin.
sentences.zh: 枪手进来时，距离礼拜开始大约只有五分钟。

sentences.en: Turn to us at this hour, oh God.
sentences.zh: 在这个时刻转向我们吧，上帝啊。

sentences.en: At the beginning of services, it's often the older folks who come in.
sentences.zh: 在礼拜开始的时候，来的往往是老年人。

sentences.en: I mean, these are older folks in congregations anyway, which is, you know, generally true in big urban houses of worship.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，无论如何，会众中这些都是老年人，你知道的，这在大城市的礼拜场所通常都是如此。

sentences.en: And particularly at the beginning of service, because the younger folks might kind of trickle in later.
sentences.zh: 尤其是在礼拜开始的时候，因为年轻人可能会晚一点陆陆续续地来。

sentences.en: So these were the most dedicated folks.
sentences.zh: 所以这些人是最虔诚的人。

sentences.en: You hear all the time of the people who came year in and year out for decades as members of these congregations.
sentences.zh: 你总是会听到，作为这些会众的成员，有些人几十年来年复一年地到来。

sentences.en: Campbell Robertson is a national reporter based in Pittsburgh.
sentences.zh: 坎贝尔·罗伯逊是一名常驻匹兹堡的国家记者。

sentences.en: There was a woman who was 97 years old.
sentences.zh: 有一个97岁的老妇人。

sentences.en: There were people in their 80s.
sentences.zh: 有80多岁的人。

sentences.en: There was a man who was 88 who got shot when he walked out of a storage room.
sentences.zh: 有一个88岁的男子，当他走出储藏室时被枪杀。

sentences.en: And the younger end of the spectrum were two brothers who were developmentally disabled.
sentences.zh: 年龄较小的一端是两名有发育障碍的兄弟。

sentences.en: They'd meet people at the door, hand out the prayer books, wish them a good Shabbat.
sentences.zh: 他们在门口迎接人们，分发祈祷书，祝他们安息日快乐。

sentences.en: They would be the first people to meet anybody, including the gunman, when they came to the front door.
sentences.zh: 当任何人（包括枪手）走到前门时，他们都是最先迎接的人。

sentences.en: And how old were the brothers?
sentences.zh: 那这两兄弟多大年纪？

sentences.en: David Rosenthal was 54.
sentences.zh: 大卫·罗森塔尔54岁。

sentences.en: And his older brother, Cecil, was 59.
sentences.zh: 他的哥哥塞西尔59岁。

sentences.en: And people in all the congregations knew them well.
sentences.zh: 所有会众的人都对他们很熟悉。

sentences.en: They were, you know, arguably among the most familiar faces in the place.
sentences.zh: 可以说，你知道的，他们是这个地方最熟悉的面孔之一。

sentences.en: 35 years ago, long before I was ever interested in public life, my wife and I wanted to pick a place where we wanted to live and raise our family.
sentences.zh: 35年前，远在我对公众生活感兴趣之前，我和妻子就想选一个我们想居住并抚养家庭的地方。

sentences.en: We decided to pick Squirrel Hill because it's a special place.
sentences.zh: 我们决定选择松鼠山，因为它是一个特殊的地方。

sentences.en: The community is so tight.
sentences.zh: 这个社区非常团结。

sentences.en: I think it is kind of unique.
sentences.zh: 我认为这有点独特。

sentences.en: We're Jews and Christians and Muslims and Buddhists and atheists and Sikhs and every faith can come together, work together, pray together, play together.
sentences.zh: 我们有犹太人、基督徒、穆斯林、佛教徒、无神论者、锡克教徒，各种信仰的人可以聚在一起，一起工作，一起祈祷，一起玩耍。

sentences.en: They're Orthodox, Reform, Conservative.
sentences.zh: 他们有正统派、改革派、保守派。

sentences.en: I'm Rabbi Ron Simons from the JCC.
sentences.zh: 我是来自犹太社区中心的罗恩·西蒙斯拉比。

sentences.en: Rabbi Danny Schiff from the Pittsburgh Federation.
sentences.zh: 来自匹兹堡联合会的丹尼·希夫拉比。

sentences.en: Tonight at a vigil.
sentences.zh: 今晚在烛光晚会上。

sentences.en: Grace and peace to each and every one of you.
sentences.zh: 愿恩典与和平降临到你们每一个人身上。

sentences.en: There were...
As-salamu alaykum, everybody.
sentences.zh: 阿萨兰姆阿莱库姆（祝你们平安），各位。

sentences.en: May peace and blessings be upon all of you.
sentences.zh: 愿和平与祝福降临在你们所有人身上。

sentences.en: ...speakers who were Catholic.
sentences.zh: ……天主教背景的发言者。

sentences.en: There was a Muslim speaker.
sentences.zh: 有一位穆斯林发言者。

sentences.en: If you need anything at all, if you need food for the families, if you just need somebody to come to the grocery store because you don't feel...
sentences.zh: 如果你需要任何东西，如果你需要为家属提供食物，如果你只是需要有人陪你去杂货店，因为你觉得……

sentences.en: And so there's really a sense that they're emphasizing this is first and foremost an attack on Tree of Life, also the Jewish community, but also Pittsburgh.
sentences.zh: 因此，人们确实有一种感觉，他们强调这首先是对“生命树”的攻击，也是对犹太社区的攻击，同时也是对匹兹堡的攻击。

sentences.en: Today, all of us, everyone in Pittsburgh, walks the mourner's path as together we seek strength for all of the tomorrows that lie ahead.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们所有的人，匹兹堡的每一个人，都在走着哀悼者的道路，我们要一起为未来的每一个明天寻找力量。

sentences.en: I want to address my fellow members and let you know what happened yesterday will not break us.
sentences.zh: 我想对我的同仁们说，昨天发生的事不会打垮我们。

sentences.en: It will not ruin us.
sentences.zh: 它不会毁灭我们。

sentences.en: We will continue to thrive and sing and worship and learn together
sentences.zh: 我们将继续繁荣发展，一起歌唱、礼拜和学习，

sentences.en: and continue our historic legacy in this city with the friendliest people that we know.
sentences.zh: 并延续我们在我们所认识的最友好的人所在的这座城市里的历史传统。

sentences.en: And as you're talking to people in Squirrel Hill and around it, what are you hearing now?
sentences.zh: 当你和松鼠山及周边的人交谈时，你现在听到了什么？

sentences.en: Well, I mean, people are still in shock.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，人们仍然处于震惊之中。

sentences.en: It's early.
sentences.zh: 现在还为时过早。

sentences.en: But the move to what is going wrong that leads to something like this is pretty quick.
sentences.zh: 但是，对于是什么出了问题导致了这样事情的发生，大家的讨论转向得相当快。

sentences.en: I mean, sometimes you cover tragic events and people want to keep the outside world as far removed as possible for as long as possible.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有时你报道悲剧事件时，人们希望尽可能长时间地把外界隔离开来。

sentences.en: Let's just focus on this.
sentences.zh: 让我们只关注这件事。

sentences.en: But in this case, people are pretty quick to say what's gone wrong in this country that allows this kind of hatred to happen.
sentences.zh: 但在这种情况下，人们很快就会指出这个国家到底出了什么问题，才导致了这种仇恨的发生。

sentences.en: And what can we do about it?
sentences.zh: 我们能做些什么呢？

sentences.en: And I'm not sure that there's an answer, but the question is asked in a lot of conversations.
sentences.zh: 我不确定是否存在答案，但在很多对话中都被问到了这个问题。

sentences.en: It takes leadership to stop this.
sentences.zh: 这需要领导力来制止这种情况。

sentences.en: And our leaders are not stopping it.
sentences.zh: 而我们的领导人并没有制止它。

sentences.en: It's too much.
sentences.zh: 这太过分了。

sentences.en: We're a civilized society.
sentences.zh: 我们是一个文明的社会。

sentences.en: We have to stay civilized.
sentences.zh: 我们必须保持文明。

sentences.en: I mean, that's what I hear.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这就是我听到的。

sentences.en: A general sort of darkness and nastiness in the national psyche right now that is allowed to keep going.
sentences.zh: 目前国家心理状态中普遍存在的某种黑暗和恶劣情绪，却被允许继续存在。

sentences.en: That's what I hear a lot about.
sentences.zh: 这就是我经常听到的。
